name: problem-copy
text: Operational facts are spread across structured records, rules, web pages, and long-form documents. Ambiguous or compound questions can select the wrong target, while unrestricted LLM use increases latency and unsupported claims.

text: OBJECTIVE  Build a local-first assistant that answers the exact user intent, cites evidence, preserves session context, and returns a safe response within a 10-second user-visible limit.

name: architecture-caption
text: Deterministic for exact facts. Semantic for unstructured knowledge. Generative only when gated.
textPreview: Deterministic for exact facts. Semantic for unstructured knowledge. Generative only when gated.

name: result-insight
text: KEY FINDING   Average latency is within the 10-second goal, but P95 remains above target. Tail latency and concurrent-user queueing are the primary production risks.

name: conclusion-body
text: The multi-route hybrid design preserves speed and correctness by using deterministic paths first, semantic retrieval for unstructured knowledge, and local LLM assistance only when it adds value. Every answer remains constrained by evidence and final validation.
